## If this is a venue request

A new venue is accepted only after the certification checklist in
[`docs/adapters.md`](../../docs/adapters.md) is satisfied. Name the market types,
the public WebSocket/REST surface, the expected capabilities and the venue
documentation. A planned venue is not a supported venue; the capability matrix is
the support claim.
